actions.action: Cut back flower spikes to just above a leaf pair
Pinch stem tips above leaf pairs every week or two
Repot into a larger pot with drainage
Feed lightly with balanced fertilizer every few weeks
Water to keep soil evenly moist, letting top dry slightly
Take 4-6 inch cuttings and root in water
Let flower spikes dry, collect and sow seed
Harden off plant outdoors over 1-2 weeks
Plant outside in full sun, rich well-draining soil, 30 cm apart
Watch for leaf spots or gray mold indicating fungal problem
